'''Cono''' was the innermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]]<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAWGG" /> Cono had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]], and its surface was covered with scorched rocks.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All of the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]]'s planets were first mentioned in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
